summary: A new story series, The Night Desk: eight stick-figure stories about Ruth, the night clerk at the Starlite Motel, each with its own prompt. Per your requirements, each part runs 1 to 2 minutes and its outro says the next part is coming tomorrow; the requirements are written down in pipeline/series/REQUIREMENTS.md. Once on, the fifth Reel each day is the next part, in order.
frontend: Nothing new on the Vault page. Each Night Desk Reel shows in History as The Night Desk with its number.
other: pipeline/series/REQUIREMENTS.md lists your requirements and what code checks each one; pipeline/series/night-desk.md has the series rules, the look and a brief per part, with extra middle beats for the longer length.

Checks for every part: 60 to 120 seconds in 20 to 50 shots, the outro says "Part N tomorrow" (the last part names none), no part number anywhere else, Ruth and the motel named in the first lines, her round glasses in every drawing, the locked ending, no other part's story, #TheNightDesk in the caption.
A part that fails is tried again in the next two hourly runs and the next day, never skipped, since its outro promised it. reels.yml can make one by hand (format series, with a part number).
